newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank acted on foreign Swedish bond sales - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank acted on foreign Swedish bond sales - dealers.

text.p: Large-scale foreign selling of Swedish bonds and purchases of dollars were behind the Riksbank's intervention in the currency market, Swedish foreign currency dealers said.
They said the Riksbank bought crowns against the dollar at 7.8550 in Wednesday morning trade after the crown weakened to about 7.86 to the dollar.
Most of the Swedish bond selling was said to be out of the U.S.
The crown was trading at 7.8270 in early trade on Wednesday, but then weakened. After the reported intervention, the unit firmed to 7.8384 to the dollar.
